name: jpipe-skills
description: EXPERIMENTAL research prototype, not a supported part of the jPipe toolchain. Skills for reviewing and operating jPipe justification models (.jd). Ships jpipe-review, which audits one model's argument for abstraction, atomicity, grounding, and house style, and jpipe-survey, which surveys a whole corpus for shared evidence, unification hazards, and available refinements. These skills review an argument a human wrote; they do not write assurance cases.
